row.title: STRAYS-1: stub files reached main by routes NATIVE-STUB-1 does not cover
row.body: The tick Worker's executor refuses a new file outside its code roots, but the branch sweep merged model branches (#698: scoreboard.py, src/connector/probe.js) and the Actions executor wrote github/workflows/checks.yml, a workflow GitHub never runs (#732). foundation/strays.py is the shared rule: it runs in checks and in the branch sweep gate (doctrine/branchsweep.json), so a merge that adds a stray is undone and ported. Six unreferenced stub files were removed from main; baseline is empty.
